system.provenance: DFT V0 fixed-cell relax (B2O3-doped LPSCl1.6 champion)

screening.caveats: fast screening estimate; deep-validation sections below are high-fidelity. cascade evolves -> re-link by (version, candidate_id).

transport.method: UMA-s-1p1 MLIP-MD, MSD window 2-50 ps, 3pt Arrhenius, Nernst-Einstein (Haven=1)
transport.caveats: MLIP NE overestimates absolute sigma ~3-5x; Ea + relative-vs-modelc robust. vs modelc (LPSCl1.6): same Ea, ~1.33x higher sigma (D0-driven).

thermodynamic_stability.method: UMA-consistent convex hull (e_above_hull), MP chemsys Li-P-S-Cl-B-O
thermodynamic_stability.caveats: metastable (+37.5 meV/atom) but phonon-stable real phase; decomp includes Li3BS3 (BS3 thioborate).

electrochemical_window.method: grand-potential ESW (MP GGA/GGA+U hull) + MP band gaps of SEI products
electrochemical_window.caveats: window narrows (1.72-2.03 V) but SEI is wide-gap passivating (B2O3 8.4, BPO4 7.0, Li3PO4 5.7) -> e- blocking.

mechanical.method: DFT relaxed-ion finite-strain Cij (running on KISTI); EOS B0 as proxy
mechanical.caveats: elastic relaxed-ion 12-strain chain running; cascade fast-estimate E~41-43 GPa (screening). EOS B0 24.5 GPa (+13% vs undoped, DFT).

structure_chemistry.caveats: BS3 confirmed 5 ways (coord/hull/DOS/ESW/charge). USPP charges = relative.

dynamical_stability.verdict: DYNAMICALLY STABLE (0 imaginary; soft Li band ~14 cm-1)
dynamical_stability.caveats: Gamma-only (UMA); qualitative stability robust; quantitative Raman/IR needs DFPT.

xps: S 2p: free-S2-(low BE) < PS4-S < B-S/BS3(high BE shoulder)
raman_ir: P-O phosphate stretch ~900-1013 cm-1 (absent in undoped)
testable_predictions.caveats: positions/order computable; Nd 3d is literature-only (multiplet). Quantitative XPS eV needs dSCF core-hole.

overall.summary: B2O3-doped LPSCl1.6 champion (cascade rank-1): higher RT conductivity than undoped (sigma300 ~18.5 mS/cm, same Ea, D0-driven), metastable but phonon-stable, narrow ESW compensated by wide-gap passivating B/O SEI, stiffer framework (EOS B0 +13%). Promising dopant.
honesty_notes: absolute sigma is MLIP upper bound (cite Ea+ratio)
elastic Cij pending (KISTI); EOS B0 proxy
cascade fast-estimates vs deep-validation differ (seeds ML calibration)
